title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! Season 2's New Video Unveils More Cast, Opening Song, October Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of Firehead and YahaKo 's A Wild Last Boss Appeared! light novel series unveiled on Tuesday the second season anime's first promotional video, seven more cast members, returning and new staff members, and October premiere.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Dokagui Daisuki! Mochizuki-san' Gets TV Anime Adaptation
content: Production company TOHO animation opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Kamome Maruyono ’s Dokagui Daisuki! Mochizuki-san ( I Love Dokagui! Mochizuki-san ) manga on Tuesday, revealing a celebratory illustration by Maruyono. Animation studio Passione is producing the anime.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Dokagui Daisuki Mochizuki-san Comedy Gourmet Anime Adaptation Announced by Toho
content: TOHO animation has revealed its latest anime project to be an adaptation of Kamome Maruyono’s Dokagui Daisuki Mochizuki-san (stylized as Dokagui Daisuki! Mochizuki-san ) comedy gourmet manga series.
author: Anime Corner

title: Suikoden: The Anime Key Visual Featuring Five Main Characters Revealed
content: Suikoden: The Anime , the anime adaptation of Suikoden II , revealed a new key visual featuring the five main characters. The anime was previously announced in March 2025 as an adaptation of Suikoden II , along with a new mobile game for the franchise.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Yasei no Last Boss ga Arawareta! 2nd Season' Reveals Additional Cast, Opening Theme, First Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Firehead 's Yasei no Last Boss ga Arawareta! ( A Wild Last Boss Appeared! ) light novel revealed additional cast, the opening theme, and first promotional video for the second season on Tuesday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared Season 2 Reveals First Trailer, New Cast, October 2026 Release
content: A Wild Last Boss Appeared has revealed its first Season 2 trailer, confirming that the anime will return in October 2026. The new preview also features the opening theme by Suspended 4th and introduces several new characters. The sequel was announced immediately after the first season’s finale.
author: Anime Corner

title: Super Psychic Policeman Chojo Anime Reveals October 6 TV Debut
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for the television anime of Shun Numa 's Super Psychic Policeman Chojo ( Chōjun! Chōjō Senpai ) manga announced on Tuesday that the anime will premiere on Kansai TV , Fuji TV , and affiliated channels throughout Japan on October 6 at 11:00 p.m. (10:00 a.m. EDT).
author: ANN

title: Pan Dorobō Anime's New Video Unveils More Cast & Staff, Opening Song
content: Kadokawa unveiled the first main promotional video and first main visual for the anime of Keiko Shibata 's Pan Dorobō (Bread Thief) picture book on Tuesday. title: Manga 'Shin Tennis no Oujisama' Concludes 27-Year Serialization
content: Takeshi Konomi 's Shin Tennis no Oujisama ( The Prince of Tennis II ) manga concluded in the September 2026 issue of Jump SQ. on Tuesday, marking the end of its nearly 27-year serialization. Konomi began serializing the sequel sports manga in Jump SQ. in March 2009. Shueisha published the 47th volume on June 4.
author: MyAnimeList
